description: This file defines a React component for a 'Delete Account' page, allowing users to confirm account deletion possibly after exporting their data. It includes UI elements like warning messages, password input, and delete/cancel buttons, handling user interactions and communication with backend API to delete the account.

classes.name: DeleteAccount
classes.description: React component class providing UI and logic for deleting a user account, including password confirmation and handling server responses.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state and binds event handler methods.

methods.name: onPasswordChanged
methods.description: Updates state with new password, sets validation flags.

methods.name: isPasswordInvalid
methods.description: Determines if the current password input is invalid based on state.

methods.name: onDeleteInvoked
methods.description: Handles delete button click, calls API, processes response, navigates or shows errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns JSX for rendering the delete account page UI.
